name: Talented Blaster
body:
Prerequisite(s): Kinetic Training, kinetic blast with at least 3 damage dice.

Benefit(s): Your kinetic blast damage and save DC are calculated as though the class which provides your kinetic blast is 4 levels higher, to a maximum effective class level equal to your character level. If multiple classes provide you with a kinetic blast, choose one class; only the chosen class benefits from this feat.
